subject: Auditor roster evaluation & retainer terms (SOC 2 / ISO renewal)
messages:
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Auditor roster evaluation: SOC 2 + ISO renewal

Team —

Attached is a one-page summary of the auditor roster for our upcoming SOC 2 and ISO renewals (see auditor_roster_summary_2028.pdf). I consolidated responses from three firms who responded to the RFP: BridgePoint Assurance, Cedar Audit LLP, and NorthStar Assurance. High-level differences:

- BridgePoint: strongest SOC 2 experience with SaaS scaleups, proposed a 10-month timeline with an optional retainer for ongoing evidence collection. Pricing is mid-market; draft SOW attached from their side (they said they'd send a formal SOW).
- Cedar: deep ISO specialization and competitive fixed price for ISO assessment; SOC 2 estimate was higher but includes controls testing services.
- NorthStar: boutique firm with flexible scheduling, higher per-day rates but good customer references.

As next steps I want us to:
1) Mark top two finalists (deadline: EOD Friday).
2) Agree on negotiable items for the retainer: monthly cap on hours, predefined SLAs for turnaround on evidence requests, and a clause for price protection if scope expands.
3) Prepare the vendor diligence packet for legal/finance if we pick a finalist.

Please review the summary and add your picks + any redlines we should insist on to auditor_questions_2028.docx. Grace — can you surface any budget constraints from Finance? Vivek — want your take on operational impact for Engineering. Aditya — can you draft a short mutual action plan template we can share with vendors?

Thanks —

Lauren Bishop
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@bridgepointassurance.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Auditor roster evaluation: SOC 2 + ISO renewal — BridgePoint SOW & pricing

Hi Lauren / team —

Thanks for the update and for considering BridgePoint. Attached are the draft SOW and pricing worksheet (BridgePoint_SOW_2028.pdf, BridgePoint_Prices.xlsx). A few notes from our side:

- Retainer: we typically structure a quarterly retainer for evidence collection and ad-hoc requests. For companies your size we propose a baseline retainer covering up to 80 hours/month with a discounted hourly rate for rollover hours.
- SLAs: 48-hour turnaround for standard evidence pulls, 72 hours for ad-hoc deeper analysis. We can tighten SLAs for an additional fee.
- Price protection: we can put a 12-month fixed fee on the retainer with a CPI-based escalation thereafter.
- Timeline: we can start readiness work immediately (pre-audit gap analysis in 2–3 weeks) and schedule testing windows to align with your release freeze windows.

A couple of clarifying questions to help finalize pricing:
1) Do you prefer a monthly or quarterly retainer cadence?
2) Roughly how many distinct evidence requests do you expect per month (ballpark)?
3) Any regulatory carve-outs (e.g., EU data hosting constraints) we should account for?

Happy to hop on a 30-minute call next week to walk the SOW line-by-line.

Regards,

Sarah Klein
VP, Client Services
BridgePoint Assurance
Attachments: BridgePoint_SOW_2028.pdf (PDF), BridgePoint_Prices.xlsx (Excel)
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 14 Jul 2028 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Auditor roster evaluation: SOC 2 + ISO renewal — BridgePoint SOW & pricing

Quick notes after reading Sarah's SOW:

- Agree BridgePoint looks like the best fit for SOC 2 continuity. Their preferred retainer model maps well to our monthly evidence churn.
- Negotiation targets: 1) cap the monthly hours at 80 with a defined hourly rate for overruns; 2) include a 30-day SLA for turnaround on critical production-impact requests rather than the 48/72 split; 3) limit escalation fees and require written approval for out-of-scope work.
- Finance check: Grace, do we have headroom for a quarterly retainer commitment vs. month-to-month? If quarterly is easier for vendor discounts, we could accept that if there's an exit clause after 90 days.

I've drafted a short mutual action plan template (MAP) that we can share — it covers milestones, owner at Redwood, owner at vendor, and acceptance criteria. Attaching MAP text to the internal folder; will push a version into the Drive link.

—Aditya
Lead, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@bridgepointassurance.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, procurement@nimblehealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Decision: proceed with BridgePoint — retainer negotiation items + next steps

Sarah — thanks for the quick turnaround and the detailed SOW. After internal review we want to proceed with BridgePoint as our primary auditor for the upcoming SOC 2 and ISO activities, pending the following retainer adjustments and legal/finance signoff:

1) Retainer cadence: we prefer a quarterly retainer with an option to convert to month-to-month after the first 90 days.
2) Hours cap: 80 hours/month baseline with a defined overage rate capped at 1.25x the agreed hourly rate; overages require prior written approval for any month >120% baseline.
3) SLAs: 48-hour turnaround for standard evidence pulls; critical production-impact requests to be handled within 24 hours with a response plan.
4) Price protection: fixed retainer for 12 months with CPI-based increases thereafter and a 30-day notice for changes.
5) Exit: 60-day termination for convenience on the retainer with pro-rated refund for unused pre-paid fees.

Please update the SOW/doc and send a DocuSign link for the retainer addendum. Looping in Finance and Procurement for billing and PO setup (Grace), and Engineering ops for scheduling (Vivek). Legal will review the updated SOW and the exit language; we expect a short review cycle if BridgePoint accepts the items above.

If you can get an updated SOW by early next week we can target a signed retainer by 7/31.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this locked in.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Attachments: auditor_questions_2028.docx
